title: Flat closed subfamilies preserve empty generic fibre interior
statement: Let $T$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme], $f:X\to T$ a locally finite type quasi-compact morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $\eta$ be a generic point of $T$, and let $U\subset T$ be an open containing $\eta$. Assume that the restrictions of $f$ and $f\circ i$ to $U$ are flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. If the inverse image of the range of $i$ in the ordinary generic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] has empty interior, then its inverse image in every ordinary fibre over $t\in U$ has empty interior.

source.place: Tag 054X, proof after applying generic flatness; Tag 03HV, generalizations lift along flat maps; Tag 054U, fibre dimension along specialization from a fibre component generic point.

proof.text: Use density of genericPoints in the ordinary fibre to select a component generic point in the assumed nonempty interior. Lift it through i using interior_subset and identify the point with asFiber via the fibre embedding. The closed-fibre comparison gives a common component point and equal dimensions.

Restrict the closed-family map to U. The base generic point specializes to the image of the selected point. Mathlib Flat.generalizingMap supplies a generalization in the restricted closed source over the generic point. Map the specialization back into Z and then into X. Apply fibre dimension preservation to both families.

Empty generic interior gives strict inequality of closed and ambient generic local dimensions. Compose the two specialization equalities with equality at the selected special point, contradicting that strict inequality.

proof_origin.place: Tag 054X, second proof paragraph. Component selection, restricted flat generalization lifting, fibre point transport and dimension contradiction are proved in Lean; dimension specialization and strict generic dimension drop are isolated.

theorem interior_fibre_closed_eq_empty_of_flat_restrict
    {Z X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral T]
    (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (η : T) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (U : T.Opens) (hηU : η ∈ U)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)]
    [Flat ((i ≫ f) ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation ((i ≫ f) ∣_ U)]
    (hgeneric : interior ((f.fiberι η) ⁻¹' Set.range i) = ∅) :
    ∀ t ∈ U, interior ((f.fiberι t) ⁻¹' Set.range i) = ∅
